name: Ipregistrty
description: Ipregistrty is a comprehensive IP address lookup service that provides detailed information about IP addresses, including geolocation, ISP details, and security insights. It helps businesses and developers enhance their applications with accurate IP data.

events.d: Get geolocation and threat data for a given IPv4 or IPv6 address.
Parse a user-agent and return browser, device & OS data that can be used to bring user experience to perfection.
